item.title: 5RAND Release ‘Double Bind’ Video from Latest Album
item.description: 5RAND have unleashed the official video for “Double Bind”, the last single taken from the band’s third album, “Ordhalia”. With “Double Bind”, Italian modern melodic death metal force 5RAND deliver their most personal and psychologically intense track to date. Written and performed by Julia Elenoir, Psychologist, Psychotherapist and songwriter, the song embodies a rare convergence of clinical insight and lived experience, transforming […]

item.title: LILLA VENEDA Present Synthwave Version of ‘Biomechanical Algorithm’ Song
item.description: Lilla Veneda was initiated and founded in 2009 in Wrocław (Poland) by Virian. Band took the name from one of the most famous Polish romantic tragedies – Lilla Weneda written by Juliusz Slowacki. Lilla Veneda unveil a transformed interpretation of “Biomechanical Algorithm”, where the original electric guitar melodies written by Antris are immersed in a slow, atmospheric synthwave landscape. item.title: AVERSIO HUMANITATIS Reveal Details of New Album “To Become the Endless Static”, Video for Title Track Out Now
item.description: Madrid’s AVERSIO HUMANITATIS follow-up 2020’s white-hot “Behold the Silent Dwellers” with another stunning slice of unrelenting, modernist and oft-dissonant Black Metal. Third full-length “To Become the Endless Static” finds the band teeth-clenched, razor-sharp, galvanised with self-belief and fortified by a characteristically immaculate production from the band’s own Simón Da Silva (CANCER, MARTRÖÐ, SELBST). item.title: Ghost Punk/Goth Garage Band HAUNTEES Released Debut Album “Shadows Forming”
item.description: Helsinki-based ghost punk and goth garage band Hauntees have released their debut album Shadows Forming.
